•  Self-attention is more than a weighted sum of previous
   word vectors; each token’s embedding is transformed into:
   Query (Q), Key (K) & Value (V)
      •  Query (Q): Represents the current token + what information
            it is searching for.
      •  Key (K): Represents what each token in the sequence has to
         offer; similarity between the query and Keys determines
        relevance.
      •  Value (V): Stores the actual information/content of each
       token that will contribute to the output.
